versions.changelog:
Initial release of content-writer-images skill.

- Enables creation of a visual brief or handling one image request for a designated article section, upon explicit user request.
- Introduces a permission gate: requires user approval for provider, prompt, submission text, section, image count, aspect ratio, and output location before any remote image request.
- Establishes a workflow for preparing briefs, confirming image details, and handling local vs. remote imagery.
- Clearly defines boundaries to prevent automatic image generation, unauthorized downloads, editing third-party work, or publishing media.
